keySentence: He hid under a basket and shook.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Peter was under the basket. He was so scared. His body was shaking. He hid under a basket and shook.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Peter crouched under the basket in the dark. His whole body was trembling with fear. He could hear Mr. McGregor searching nearby. He hid under a basket and shook with terror. The old man muttered and walked away slowly. Peter stayed hidden, too afraid to move.
